# Humanly — Confidential HR Advisory for UAE & GCC Professionals

## What Humanly Does
Humanly provides independent, confidential HR guidance and coaching for professionals in the UAE and GCC. It helps individuals prepare for workplace challenges such as PIPs, toxic management dynamics, harassment documentation, redundancy, severance, resignation decisions, burnout, and employee-rights questions.

Humanly is not a law firm and does not provide legal representation.

## Founder and Expertise
Karma Harb is the founder and principal HR advisor. Humanly states that Karma has 20+ years of HR leadership experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and international environments.

## Services and Pricing
- The Triage: 60-minute confidential advisory session — AED 550
- The Strategy: confidential session plus written follow-up report — AED 950
- The Retainer: ongoing monthly support — AED 1,800/month

## Payment and Booking Flow
Clients choose a service, complete a private intake, pay through Stripe Checkout, then schedule through a paid-only Cal.com scheduling page. Stripe handles card details and payment failure states.

## Paid Resources
Humanly offers free and premium PDF resources. Premium resources unlock only after Stripe confirms successful payment.

## Trust and Testimonials
Humanly is early-stage and does not publish fake client testimonials. Future testimonials should be verified, consented, privacy-safe, lazy-loaded, and accompanied by transcripts for SEO and accessibility.
